name: Hermes Agent

version_poll.transform: date tag vYYYY.M.D(.N) from tag_name; semver app version from the release title, e.g. 'Hermes Agent v0.21.2 (v2026.9.11)'; display 'vX.Y.Z (YYYY.M.D)'; use the semver for the changelog id

cross_check: release title vs tag; NEVER use PyPI hermes-agent (lags badly)
release_notes: Narrative essays covering hundreds of commits — summarize, extracting ONLY items touching the scope_allowlist surface; ignore everything else.
gotchas: General-purpose agent — placemat covers the CLI/TUI coding surface ONLY (scope_allowlist); never add anything on the scope_denylist
The docs site 404s on .md — ALWAYS fetch markdown from raw_mirror instead
Dual versioning: date tag + semver title; tag date can differ from publish date; same-day .N patch tags
llms-full.txt is ~3.7 MB — never ingest whole; use /docs/llms.txt to detect page churn
Docs pages rename frequently — re-derive paths from llms.txt when a fetch 404s
The scope note beside the legend must stay generic: naming excluded features in index.html would defeat the denylist grep that guards the scope

Slash commands live in table cells with trailing args (e.g. `` `/compress [here [N]]` ``) — a naive regex requiring the closing backtick right after the command name misses most of them; extract the leading `/word` token instead

config.yaml keys are documented as nested YAML, not dotted paths — the placemat's dotted chips (e.g. `terminal.timeout`) are our own notation for a vendor `terminal: { timeout: ... }` block; verify the leaf key name against the nested example, not a literal dotted string search
auxiliary.review is documented only in reference/slash-commands (the /review row), not in user-guide/configuration — check both before marking a settings key unverified

The vendor documents a deep event-hooks system (user-guide/features/hooks.md: gateway hooks, plugin hooks, shell hooks, outbound webhooks) that this placemat's card-hooks ('Automation & MCP') does not cover at all — that card holds only /cron, /goal, /kanban and MCP-adjacent slash commands, which is a scope choice, not a gap; the hooks array below still lists every event/hook name the vendor page documents for completeness

inventory.note: slash extracted from reference/slash-commands.md (including CLI-only aliases confirmed in reference/cli-commands.md); settings extracted from user-guide/configuration.md's nested YAML examples (leaf key names), cross-checked against reference/slash-commands.md and reference/cli-commands.md for keys only mentioned inline (auxiliary.review, model.persist_switch_by_default, display.interface); hooks extracted from user-guide/features/hooks.md across all four documented hook systems (gateway, plugin, shell, outbound webhook) — none currently appear as rows on this placemat's card-hooks, which scopes to automation/MCP slash commands instead.
